exact: evasion of host innate immune response
related: evasion of host innate immune recognition

definition: A process by which a symbiont avoids recognition by host's innate immune response by altering, concealing or destroying a conserved symbiont molecule recognized by the host. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated evasion of host innate immune response
